method: Post-hoc focused upstream regression and added-test audit, motivated by unexecuted model-added tests and changed absent-option config shapes. Exact archived production source is never repaired. Run the same related upstream assertions/types for every arm/repeat, and separately execute exact model-added/modified tests. Baseline controls distinguish pre-existing failures and harness configuration problems. This is not the full upstream suite or an official selected check. Dependencies are isolated outside the measured repository, installed with a separate npm cache and pinned lock.
